title: LORD, LEAD ME SAFELY THROUGH THIS STORM
text: Beloved, I greet you in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, the name that is above every name, the name before which every knee must bow. Glory be to God. I want you to understand that this morning, as you have positioned yourself in the place of prayer, you have not come by accident. The spirit of the living God has orchestrated this divine encounter. There is a stirring in the heavenlies, and I decree that whatever storm has surrounded your life, whatever tempest has risen against your peace, your progress, your destiny this morning, the Lord himself will lead you through it safely. [music] I'm talking about the God who parted the Red Sea, the God who shut the mouths of lions, the God who walked on water and commanded the winds to be still. That same God is about to manifest his power in your situation. You know, when I look at the scripture, I am reminded of the faithfulness of God in the midst of crisis. The Bible is filled with stories of men and women who faced impossible situations, storms that threatened to swallow their destiny, circumstances that look like the end of their journey. But in every single case, God showed up. In every single case, God proved himself faithful. And I want to prophesy to you this morning that your case will not be different. The storm you are facing right now, whether it is financial, whether it is in your health, whether it is in your marriage, whether it is confusion about your purpose, whether it is attacks from the kingdom of darkness, I decree that you shall not drown in that storm, you shall not be consumed by that tempest, the Lord will lead you through safely. Let me take you to the word of God. Open your spirit. In Psalm 107, verses 28 to 30, the Bible says, "Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distresses. He calmed the storm so that its waves were still. Then they were glad because they were quiet, [music] so he guided them to their desired haven." Do you see the pattern? First, there was a storm. Second, they cried out to the Lord. Third, God intervened and calmed the storm. Fourth, he guided them to their desired heaven, to their place of purpose, to their place of destiny, to the safe harbor that God had prepared for them. This is exactly what is happening in your life this morning. You have cried out and now God is responding. He's calming your storm and he's guiding you to your desired heaven. I want you to share this ministration with someone. Don't keep it to yourself. There is somebody in your contact list, somebody in your family, somebody in your workplace who is going through a terrible storm right now. They need to hear this word. They need to be reminded that God has not forgotten them. [music] Share this prayer with them. Send it to them right now even as you are listening. Because when [music] you become a channel of blessing, when you become a distributor of hope, God opens up channels of blessing in your own life that you never imagined. The Bible says, "Give and it shall be given unto you." So, share this word, share this prayer and watch what God will do. Now, I need you to understand something about storms. Storms are not just natural occurrences. They are often spiritual realities. When the enemy sees that you are about to enter into your season of manifestation, when he sees that you are about to cross over into the land of your inheritance, he [music] raises storms. He raises obstacles. He raises confusion. He raises opposition. Why? Because he knows that if you get to the other side, his kingdom will suffer loss. Your breakthrough is a threat to the kingdom of darkness. Your success is a threat to demonic establishments. Your joy is a threat to the agenda of hell. And so, the enemy fights you not because [music] you are weak, but because you are dangerous. He fights you not because you are insignificant, but because you carry a destiny that destroy his works. I'm reminded of the disciples in the boat with Jesus in Mark chapter 4. The Bible says they were crossing over to the other side when suddenly a great windstorm arose. The waves were beating into the boat and the boat was already filling with water. Meanwhile, Jesus was in the stand asleep on a pillow. Now, I want you to catch this revelation. Jesus had already said, "Let us cross over to the other side." He did not say, "Let us go halfway and drown." He did not say, "Let us go to the middle of the sea and perish." He said, "Let us cross over to the other side." This means the storm was not the will of God. The storm was the opposition of the enemy trying to prevent them from reaching their destination. But listen to me, because Jesus said you are crossing over, no storm can stop you. Because Jesus has declared your victory, no tempest can abort your destiny. You see, the problem with the disciples was that they panicked. They woke Jesus up and said, "Teacher, do you not care that we are perishing?" And I wonder how many of us have asked God the same question. "Lord, do you not care that I'm struggling? Do you not care that I'm in pain? Do you not care that the storm is overwhelming me?" But I want you to know that God cares. He cares deeply. He cares intimately. He cares personally. The Bible says he keeps your tears in a bottle. He numbers the hairs on your head. He knows when a sparrow falls to the ground. If he cares about sparrows, how much more does he care about you, whom he created in his own image, whom he redeemed with the precious blood of his son? Jesus stood up in that boat and he rebuked the wind. He said to the sea, "Peace, be still." And the Bible says the wind ceased and there was a great calm. Now, listen to me very carefully. The same Jesus who calmed the storm on the Sea of Galilee is the same Jesus who is alive today. He's the same yesterday, today, [music] and forever. He has not lost his power. He has not lost his authority. He has not retired from the business of performing miracles. And this morning by the authority vested in his name, I speak to every storm in your life, "Peace, be still." I command every wind of adversity to cease. I command every wave of trouble to calm down. I decree that the same power that calmed the Sea [music] of Galilee is calming the storm in your finances, in your health, in your relationships, in your destiny, in Jesus' mighty name. But there's something else I want you to see. After Jesus calmed the storm, he asked the disciples a question. He said, "Why are you so fearful? How is it that you have no faith?" You see, Jesus was not just concerned about the storm. He was concerned about their response to the storm. He was concerned about their faith. Because faith is what activates the power of God. Faith is what moves mountains. Faith is what silences the enemy. And if you are going through a storm without faith, you will suffer unnecessarily. But if you face the storm with faith, you will see the glory of God manifested. The Bible says in Hebrews 11:6, "Without faith, it is impossible to please God. For he who comes to God must believe that he is and that he's a rewarder of those who diligently seek him." So this morning, I'm calling you to activate your faith. Don't just pray. Pray with faith. Don't just read the word. Read it with faith. Don't just confess. Confess with faith. Because when faith is released, heaven responds. When faith is released, angels are dispatched. When faith is released, demons [music] tremble. When faith is released, storms obey. I prophesy over your life this morning. You are coming out of that storm. You are not just surviving, you are thriving. You are not just getting by, you are breaking through. The storm that came to destroy you is going to become a testimony of God's faithfulness. The trial that came to break you is going to become a platform for your promotion. What the enemy meant for evil, God is turning around for your good. Genesis 50 to 20. What they meant for evil, God meant it for good. What the devil meant to kill you with, God is using it to set you up for a greater level of glory. Now, let me shift your perspective for a moment. Sometimes we go through storms because [music] God is taking us from one level to another. Not every storm is an attack from the enemy. Sometimes God allows a storm because he's stretching you, preparing you, refining you for the next dimension of your calling. The Bible says in James 1:2-4, "My brethren, count it all joy when you fall into various trials, knowing that the testing of your faith produces [music] patience. But let patience have its perfect work, that you may be perfect [music] and complete, lacking nothing." Do you see that? The storm is not just a test, [music] it is a training ground. It is a classroom where God is teaching you how to trust him at a deeper level, how to stand in faith when everything around you is shaking. I'm reminded of Joseph. He went through a series of storms, betrayed by his brothers, sold into slavery, falsely accused by Potiphar's wife, thrown into prison, forgotten by the butler. Storm after storm after storm. But every storm was actually a set up for his destiny. Every storm was positioning him for the palace. Every storm was teaching him something he needed to know to govern Egypt. And when Pharaoh finally called him out of the prison, Joseph was ready. He had been trained by the storms. He had been refined by the trials. He had been prepared by the process. So, if you are in a storm right now, don't despise it. Don't waste it. Extract the lessons. Gain the wisdom. Develop the character because on the other side of this storm is a throne. On the other side of this trial is a testimony. On the other side of this test is a triumph. And when you get there, when you finally arrive at your palace, you will look back and thank God for every storm, because you will realize that the storm was necessary to make you who you needed to be. But let me also address those of you who are in a storm [music] because of direct satanic attack. Yes, there are storms that come because the enemy is fighting your destiny. There are storms that are orchestrated by witchcraft, by jealousy, by the powers of darkness that do not want to see you prosper. And for those storms, you don't need to just pray, you need to wage war. You need to take authority. You need to bind and loose. You need to decree and declare. The Bible says in Matthew 16:19, [music] "I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven." You have authority, you have power, you have the name of Jesus. I want to encourage you this morning to rise up in spiritual violence. The Bible says the kingdom of heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force. This is not the time to be passive. This is not the time to be timid. This is not the time to just fold your hands and hope things get better. You [music] need to pray, you need to fast, you need to declare the word of God over your situation. You need to take your position as a king and a priest. You need to exercise the authority that Jesus has given you. Let me pray for you right now. But before I pray, I want you to position yourself. If you are sitting, stand up. If you are lying down, get up. Lift up your hands to the Lord. Open your mouth and begin to pray in the spirit. Begin to speak in tongues if you have the gift. [music] Begin to call on the name of Jesus. This is not a spectator moment, this is a participation moment. This is your deliverance. This is your breakthrough. This is your miracle. So, engage your spirit, release your faith, and let us storm the gates of heaven together. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace this morning, lifting up every person who is listening to this word right now. Lord, you see them, you know them. You know their names, you know their situations, you know the storms they are facing, you know the battles they are fighting, you know the burdens they are carrying. And Lord, I ask in the name of Jesus that you would intervene in their circumstances. I ask that you would manifest your power in a way they have never experienced before. Lord, let this be their moment of divine encounter. Let this be their moment of supernatural turn around. I speak to every financial storm, and I command it to cease in the name of Jesus. Every door that has been shut against you, I decree that it is opening now by the master key of heaven. Every source that has dried up, I decree that it is flowing again by the rivers of divine provision. Every debt that has tormented you, I decree that supernatural cancellation is your portion. Every lack that has embarrassed you, I decree that abundance is coming your way. The Bible says, "My God shall supply all your needs according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." So, I decree that supply is coming. Provision is coming. Overflow is coming in the name of Jesus. I speak to every health storm, every sickness, every disease, every infirmity, I command it to bow to the name of Jesus. Every pain in your body, I command it to leave now. Every diagnosis that has been spoken over you, I cancel it by the blood of Jesus. Every symptom that has manifested, I decree that it is disappearing now. The Bible says, "By his stripes, you were healed." Not you will be healed, but you were healed. It is already done. So, I decree that healing is manifesting in your body now. [music] Strength is returning, vitality is returning, health is returning in the name of Jesus. I speak to every marital storm, every storm in your relationship, every storm in your home, I command peace to reign. [music] I command love to flourish. I command understanding to prevail. Every spirit of division, I bind you now. Every spirit of strife, I cast you out. Every spirit of confusion, I rebuke you in the name of Jesus. I decree that your marriage is entering into a season of restoration, a season of renewal, a season of divine romance. What God has joined together, no devil can put asunder. Your home shall be a heaven of peace, a center of love, a testimony of God's grace. In the name of Jesus, I speak to every storm of confusion, every storm of uncertainty about your purpose, your calling, your direction. I decree [music] that divine clarity is coming. The Bible says the steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord. So, I decree that God is ordering your steps. He's directing your path. He's illuminating your way. Every fog of confusion is lifting. Every cloud of uncertainty is clearing. You shall know what to do. You shall know where to go. You shall know when to move. The spirit of the Lord will guide you into all truth. In the name of Jesus. I speak to every storm that has been raised by witchcraft, by jealousy, by evil altars, by satanic conspiracies. I decree that those storms are terminated now. Every evil arrow that has been fired against you, I command it to go back to the sender. Every curse that has been pronounced over your life, I break it by the blood of Jesus. Every evil covenant that has been established against your destiny, I nullify it by the authority of heaven. Every satanic agenda that has been plotted against you, I scatter it by the fire of the Holy Ghost. You are covered by the blood of Jesus. You are protected by the angels of God. You are fortified by the power of the Most High. No weapon formed against you shall prosper, >> [music] >> and every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn. This is your heritage as a servant of the Lord in Jesus mighty name. Father, I ask that you would lead them safely through this storm. Just as you led the children of Israel through the Red Sea on dry ground. Just as you led Noah through the flood. Just as you led Paul through the shipwreck. Lead them through this storm. Be their guide. Be their protector. Be their deliverer. Let your presence go with them. Let your hand uphold them. Let your grace sustain them. And when they come out on the other side, let them come out with a testimony that will glorify your [music] name. With a miracle that will strengthen the faith of others. With a breakthrough that will declare to the world that our God reigns. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I have prayed. Amen. Now, I want you to understand something very important. As you go through this storm, you must maintain your confession. You must watch what comes out of your mouth. The Bible says death and life are in the power of the tongue, and [music] those who love it will eat its fruit. Your words have creative power. Your words can either build or destroy. Your words can either invite angels or empower demons. So, you must speak faith. You must speak life. You must speak victory. Stop saying I'm finished. I'm destroyed. I can't make it. This is too much for me. No. Those are words of defeat, and they will only prolong your suffering. Instead, begin to say I am more than a conqueror through Christ who loves me. I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me. Greater is he that is in me than he that is in the world. The Lord is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The Lord is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid? These are the words you must speak. These are the confessions you must make. And as you speak them, as you declare them, as you meditate on them, they will begin to create a reality in your life. I remember the story of Elijah. He was a mighty prophet, a man who called down fire from heaven, a man who shut up the heaven so that it did not rain for 3 and 1/2 years. But there came a moment when Elijah faced a storm, not a physical storm, but a storm of fear, a storm of discouragement, a storm of depression. Jezebel sent a message threatening to kill him. And the Bible says Elijah ran for his life. He went into the wilderness and sat under a juniper tree and prayed that he might die. He said, "It is enough. Now, Lord, take my life, for I am no better than my fathers." Have you ever felt like Elijah? Have you ever been in a place where you just wanted to give up? Where the storm was so intense that you felt like you couldn't go on? I want you to know that God did not condemn Elijah. He did not rebuke him. He did not reject him. Instead, he sent an angel to minister to him. The angel touched him and said, "Arise and eat because the journey is too great for you." And God provided supernatural sustenance, bread baked on coals and a jar of water. Elijah ate and drank and then lay down again. But the angel came back a second time and said, "Arise and eat because the journey is too great for you." And Elijah ate and drank again. And the Bible says he went in the strength of that food for 40 days and 40 nights. What is God saying through this story? He is saying that when you are in a storm, when you are overwhelmed, when you are exhausted, he will provide what you need to sustain you. He will send angels. He will send help. He will send strength. He will send grace. You are not alone, you are not abandoned, you are not forgotten. God is with you in the storm and he will give you the strength to make it through. But there's more to the story. After Elijah was strengthened, God led him to Mount Horeb, the mountain of God. And there in a cave, God spoke to him. He said, "What are you doing here, Elijah?" And Elijah poured out his heart. He told God about his frustrations, his fears, his sense of failure and God responded in a remarkable way. He told Elijah to stand on the mountain before the Lord. And then the Bible says a great and strong wind tore into the mountains and broke the rocks in pieces, but the Lord was not in the wind. And after the wind and earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake. And after the earthquake, a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire, a still, small voice. Do you see what God is teaching us? Sometimes in the midst of the storm, the wind, the earthquake, the fire, we are looking for God to show up in a spectacular way. We are looking for a dramatic intervention. We are looking for a miracle that will blow our minds, but God says, "I am in the still, small voice." God is saying if you will quiet your soul, if you will calm your spirit, if you will listen carefully, you will hear me. You will hear my guidance. You will hear my direction. You will hear my reassurance. So, in the midst of your storm, create space for silence. Create space for stillness. Create space to hear the voice of God. Don't let the noise of the storm drown out the voice of the [music] spirit. Don't let the chaos of your circumstances distract you from the whisper of heaven. Get alone with God. Get quiet before God. Get still in the presence of God and you will [music] hear him speak. You will hear him guide you. You will hear him lead you safely through [music] the storm. Let me share with you another dimension of this truth. In 2 Chronicles 20, we read about King Jehoshaphat. The Bible says a great multitude came against him to battle the people of Moab, the people of Ammon, and others with them. Jehoshaphat was afraid, but he set himself to seek the Lord. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah. And the people gathered together to ask help from the Lord. Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly and prayed one of the most powerful prayers in the Bible. He said, "O Lord God of our fathers, are you not God in heaven? And do you not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations? And in your hand is there not power and might, so that no one is able to withstand you?" He rehearsed the faithfulness of God. He reminded God of his promises. And then he came to the heart of his prayer. "O our God, will you not judge them? For we have no power against this great multitude that is coming against us. Nor do we know what to do, but our eyes are upon you." I love that confession. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are upon you. That is the posture of faith. That is the posture of dependence. That is the posture of trust. Jehoshaphat was saying, "Lord, I am out of my depth. This storm is bigger than me. This battle is beyond my ability, but I am not looking to my strength. I am not looking to my wisdom. I am not looking to my resources. My eyes are upon you." And how did God respond? The spirit of the Lord came upon Jahaziel, a Levite, and he prophesied. He said, "Do not be afraid nor dismayed because of this great multitude, for the battle is not yours, but [music] God's. Tomorrow, go down against them. You will not need to fight in this battle. Position yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord who is with you. What a word. [music] What a promise. What an assurance. And the next day, when Jehoshaphat and the people of Judah went out to the wilderness, they did something unusual. They appointed singers to go ahead of the army singing and praising the Lord. And as they began to sing and to praise, the Bible says the Lord set ambushes against the enemy and they were defeated. By the time Jehoshaphat and his people arrived, all their enemies were dead bodies on the ground. They did not have to fight. They just had to praise. They just had to worship. They just had to trust God. This is a powerful revelation for you this morning. In the midst of your storm, praise is a weapon. Worship is a weapon. Thanksgiving is a weapon. When you lift up your voice and begin to worship God, when you begin to magnify his name, when you begin to declare his goodness, something happens in the spiritual realm. The enemy is confused, demons are scattered, strongholds are broken, and God begins to fight [music] on your behalf. So, I'm calling you to a lifestyle of praise. Don't wait until the storm is over to praise God. Praise him in the storm. Don't wait until you see the breakthrough to worship him. Worship him while you are waiting. Don't wait until you receive the answer to thank him. Thank him in advance for what he's going to do. The Bible says in everything give [music] thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you. In everything, not after everything, but in everything. Not when everything is perfect, but when everything is chaotic, give thanks. Give praise. Give worship. And as you do, you will discover what Paul and Silas discovered in the Philippian jail. At midnight, beaten and bruised, their feet in stocks, they prayed and sang praises to God. And suddenly there was a great earthquake. And the foundations of the prison were shaken. And immediately all the doors were opened and everyone's chains were loosed. Praise brought deliverance. Worship brought freedom. Thanksgiving brought a miracle. I declare over your life this morning, as you begin to praise God in your storm, doors are opening, chains are breaking, prisons are shaking, limitations are lifting, the enemy's grip is being loosened, and you are stepping into a new dimension of freedom, a new dimension of favor, a new dimension of glory, in the name of Jesus. Now, let me also address the issue of timing. One of the most difficult aspects of going through a storm is not knowing when it will end. You pray, and it seems like nothing is happening. You fast, and the situation remains the same. You believe God, but the breakthrough is delayed. And you begin to wonder, "How long, Lord? How long will this storm last? How long will I have to endure this trial?" I want to encourage you with the story of the woman with the issue of blood in Mark chapter 5. The Bible says she had suffered for 12 YEARS. 12 YEARS. She had spent all that she had on physicians, and she was not better, but rather grew worse. 12 years of pain, 12 years of shame, 12 years of isolation, 12 years of unanswered prayers. But then, one day, she heard about Jesus, and something rose up in her spirit. She said within herself, "If only I may touch his clothes, I shall be made well." Notice that her breakthrough did not come in year one, it did not come in year five, it did not come in year 10, it came in year 12. [music] Why? Because there is a set time for your deliverance. There is an appointed time for your breakthrough. There is a kairos moment that God has already determined. And even though you cannot see it, even though you cannot feel it, even though you cannot understand it, that moment is coming. Your time is [music] coming. Your season is coming. Your day of visitation is coming. The Bible says in Habakkuk 2:2-3, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it will speak, and it will not lie. Though it tarries, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry. Do you see that? Though it tarries, wait for it. It will surely come. Your miracle will surely come. Your healing will surely come. Your restoration will surely come. Your promotion will surely come. It is just a matter of time. So, don't give up. Don't quit. Don't throw in the towel. Don't surrender to despair. The storm may be fierce right now, but it is not permanent. The night may be dark right now, but weeping endures for a night, and joy comes in the morning. Your morning is coming. Your dawn is breaking. Your sun is rising. And when it does, every shadow of your past will disappear. Every memory of the storm will fade. Every trace of the pain will be [music] healed, and you will stand in the fullness of God's blessing, in the abundance of God's provision, in the glory of God's favor. I prophesy over you right now. This is your season of suddenly. Suddenly, God is going to turn things around. Suddenly, the storm is going to cease. Suddenly, the answer is going to come. Suddenly, the door is going to open. Suddenly, the healing is going to manifest. Suddenly, the breakthrough is going to happen. It may not look like it right now, but God specializes in the suddenly. He is the God of the suddenly, and your suddenly is here. Your suddenly is now. Your suddenly is activated in the mighty name of Jesus. Let me take you to one more scripture before we go deeper into prayer. In Acts chapter 27, we read about Paul's journey to Rome. He was on a ship with 276 people, and they encountered a tempestuous [music] storm. The Bible says they faced a storm so fierce that for many days neither sun nor stars appeared, and all hope that they would be saved was finally given up. Can you imagine? All hope was gone. They had resigned themselves to death. They had had that they were not going to make it. But in the middle of that hopeless situation, Paul stood up and said, "Men, you should have listened to me. Nevertheless, I urge you to take heart, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship. For there stood by me this night an angel of the God to whom I belong and whom I serve saying, 'Do not be afraid, Paul. You must be brought before Caesar, and indeed God has granted you all those who sail with you. Therefore, take heart, men, for I believe God that it will be just as it was told me.'" What was Paul saying? He was saying, "In the middle of the storm, God sent me a message. In the middle of the crisis, God sent me an assurance. In the middle of the chaos, God sent me a promise, and I believe God. I believe that it will be just as he said." And you know what happened? Every single person on that ship survived. They lost the ship, but they did not lose their lives. They lost their cargo, but they did not lose their destiny. And I want to prophesy to you this morning, you may lose some things in this storm. You may lose some relationships. You may lose some possessions. You may lose some comfort, but you will not lose your life. You will not lose your destiny. You will not lose your purpose. God is going to bring you through. God is going to preserve you. God is going to deliver you. And when you step onto the shore of your breakthrough, you will realize that everything you lost in the storm was actually preparing you for everything you are going to gain in the next season. Now, I want to lead us into a time of militant prayer. This is the place where we take authority. This is the place where we enforce the victory of Calvary. This is the place where we bind and loose. This is the place where we decree and declare. So, open your mouth. Lift up your voice. Pray with violence. Pray with authority. Pray with faith. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come against every storm that has been orchestrated by the kingdom of darkness. I I against every assignment of hell that has been released against the destiny of your people. I take authority over every demon, every principality, every power, every ruler of darkness, every spiritual host of wickedness in the heavenly places. I bind you, I rebuke you, I cast you out. I command you to take your hands off the lives of God's children. You have no authority here, you have no power here, you have no right here. The blood of Jesus has disqualified you. The name of Jesus has defeated you. The cross of Jesus has destroyed you. So, I command you to flee now in the mighty name of Jesus. Every storm of poverty, I bind you. Every storm of sickness, I bind you. Every storm of failure, I bind you. Every storm of delay, I bind you. Every storm of confusion, I bind you. Every storm of fear, >> [music] >> I bind you. You are terminated, you are canceled, you are nullified by the authority of heaven, by the power of the blood, by the victory of the cross. I decree that you are finished in the name of Jesus. I speak to every gate [music] that has been shut against divine favor. I command you to open now. I speak to every door that has been locked against divine opportunity. I command you to open now. I speak to every barrier that has been erected against divine promotion. I command you to be removed now. The Bible says, "Lift up your heads, all you gates, and be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in." So, I decree that every gate is lifting up, every door is opening, every barrier is coming down, and the King of glory is coming into your situation with his power, with his provision, with his peace in the name of Jesus. I decree fresh grace. I decree supernatural strength. I decree divine wisdom. I decree uncommon favor. I decree unusual miracles. I decree signs and wonders. I decree angels ascending and descending upon your life. I decree heavenly intervention. I decree divine orchestration. I decree supernatural alignment. Everything that needs to come together for your breakthrough is coming together now. Every person who needs to show up for your next level is showing up now. Every resource that needs to be released for your advancement is being released now in the mighty name of Jesus. And now, receive this prophetic declaration. The Lord says, "I have heard your cry. I have seen your tears. I have noted your faithfulness, and I am moved with compassion toward you." This storm that you are in, it is not the end of your story. It is a transition to your testimony. It is a passage to your palace. It is a bridge to your breakthrough. So, do not faint. Do not fear. Do not fail. For I am with you. I am leading you. I am carrying you. And I will bring you out on the other side with greater glory, greater anointing, greater authority, greater influence than you have ever known. This is your season of supernatural advancement. This is your season of uncommon favor. This is your season of miraculous turnaround. Receive it now in the name of Jesus. Somebody shout amen. Glory to God. I want you to begin to thank God right now. Begin to worship him. Begin to magnify his name because your deliverance is done. Your breakthrough has been released. Your miracle has been activated.
